name: Native workbench
description: A native UAI panel with working notes, live request counts and project actions.
author: Project UAI

sources.label: Native UAI panel declarations and lifecycle

source:
return function(context)
	local panel = assert(context:CreatePanel({ id = "workbench", title = "Project workbench", description = "Working notes and project actions inside Project UAI." }))
	local notes = assert(panel:Section({ id = "notes", title = "Working notes", description = "Retained for this loaded mod, including appearance changes." }))
	notes:Input({ id = "scratchpad", text = "Scratchpad", value = "", multiline = true, placeholder = "Write your next step" })
	local overview = assert(panel:Section({ id = "overview", title = "Conversation overview" }))
	local status = assert(overview:Text({ id = "requests", text = "Reading request count" }))
	local sessions = context.require("agent/session")
	local function refresh()
		if not context:IsAlive() or not panel:IsAlive() then return end
		local current = sessions.current()
		local metrics = current.modMetrics()
		status:Set("Requests: " .. tostring(metrics.requests or "Unavailable"))
	end
	overview:Button({ id = "refresh", text = "Refresh request count", callback = refresh })
	overview:Button({ id = "vault", text = "Open Master Vault", callback = function() context.app.show("vault") end })
	overview:Button({ id = "code", text = "Open Code", callback = function() context.app.show("code") end })
	context:Connect(sessions.listChanged, refresh)
	context:Connect(sessions.usageChanged, refresh)
	refresh()
	panel:Show()
end
